summary: Muhammad Abuzar came into the session fatigued from a high-pressure week of late nights working toward a product deadline. The central focus was his promotion conversation with his manager, which he had fully prepared for but ultimately postponed at the last moment.
keyThemes: Promotion conversation avoidance despite full preparation
Work fatigue and its impact on confidence and follow-through
insights: Muhammad had all the material ready yet still chose to reschedule, indicating the blocker is emotional/psychological, not logistical.
Fatigue from late nights appears to be eroding his confidence.

actionItems.text: Follow up with your manager to reschedule the promotion conversation — set a specific date this week.

coachActionItems.text: Focus next session on the psychological hesitation, not just tactical preparation.

followUpTopics: Outcome of the rescheduled promotion conversation
Root cause of last-minute hesitation despite full preparation
coachObservations: This is a confidence and self-worth issue, not a preparation issue.
